What is an Unshaven Hair Transplant?

Hair Restoration That Fits Your Lifestyle

Unlike traditional methods, this technique restores your hair without fully shaving your scalp—so you can get treated without anyone knowing.
An unshaven hair transplant (also known as U-FUE) allows us to extract and implant hair follicles without shaving the recipient area or, in some cases, even the donor zone.

It’s especially popular among women, working professionals, celebrities, and anyone who values privacy during their treatment.

This technique delivers natural, permanent results—with no obvious signs of surgery.

How It Works?

The Same Trusted FUE Method—Just More Discreet

We use precision tools to extract and implant individual follicles—without shaving your head.
✅ Step 1: Hairline Planning & Area Mapping
We identify thinning zones and design a natural-looking hairline to match your current hair.
✅ Step 2: Selective Graft Extraction
Only a small portion of the donor area (at the back) is trimmed—leaving the rest of your hair untouched.
✅ Step 3: Micro-Implantation in Recipient Area
Grafts are carefully implanted along designed hairline and between existing hair strands—without shaving the area.
✅ Step 4: Recovery & Follow-Up
You can return to work in 1–2 days with no visible signs of the procedure.
✅ Step 5: Recovery & Support
You’ll receive full post-care instructions and regular follow-ups to ensure optimal results.
